name: Manassas city, VA
findings: Manassas city has 4 nonprofit organizations. 2 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 2 organizations.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
